# OOX Limited: Game \& App Development Studio

## Posts
- [Rapid Prototyping in Game Development: A Studio’s Guide](https://ooxlimited.com/rapid-prototyping-game-development-2/): Rapid prototyping is not a rough draft of a game — it is a structured validation instrument that tests whether a core loop is fun before a studio commits months of production to it\. The methodology answers one question: should this idea keep moving forward? Used correctly, a two\-week prototype that kills a bad idea saves the six months of production that idea would have consumed\.
- [The Prototyping\-First Studio: Why Validation Comes Before](https://ooxlimited.com/prototyping-first-studio-validation-before-building-2026/)
- [Mobile Game Vertical Slice: What to Prove Before Production](https://ooxlimited.com/mobile-game-vertical-slice-prove-before-production/): A mobile game vertical slice proves your team can ship at quality\. Before full production, validate the four things that determine whether a game ships or dies\.
- [Mobile Game Narrative Design: Stories in 47 Seconds](https://ooxlimited.com/game-narrative-design-mobile-games-2026/)
- [How a Mobile Game Development Team Works: Roles, Handoffs](https://ooxlimited.com/mobile-game-development-team-roles-workflow-handoffs/)

## Services
- [Real\-Time VFX](https://ooxlimited.com/service/real-time-vfx/): High\-quality visual effects that enhance gameplay clarity, feedback, and overall player experience\.
- [Platform Porting](https://ooxlimited.com/service/platform-porting/): Adapt your game to new platforms while maintaining performance, stability, and user experience across devices\.
- [Game Video ads](https://ooxlimited.com/service/game-video-ads/): Engaging video ads and creatives designed to showcase gameplay and improve user acquisition performance\.
- [App Development](https://ooxlimited.com/service/app-development/): Custom mobile app development focused on usability, performance, and scalable architecture\.
- [Co development](https://ooxlimited.com/service/co-development/): We work as an extension of your team, supporting specific areas of development while staying aligned with your workflow and production goals\.
